g.text: Quarters relative to the first quarter after coverage ended or lapsed (dashed line)
Change in prescriptions, 2025 Q4 to 2026 Q1 (observed counts; axis capped at +100%)
Source: CMS State Drug Utilization Data and Medicaid enrollment (warehouse marts). Gross of rebates; counts under 11 suppressed by CMS. 2026 Q1 is
preliminary SDUD data; only one post-withdrawal quarter exists for most states (North Carolina lapsed 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-11 and resumed). New
Preliminary and descriptive: no model, no p-values. All-drug SDUD prescriptions changed -26.0% in CA, -51.0% in PA and a median of
-17.9% in the continuously covered states over the same quarters, so part of any drop may be incomplete preliminary data.
2025 Q4 to 2026 Q1: Wegovy/Zepbound prescriptions changed -75.7% in CA and -95.5% in PA after
coverage ended, versus a median of -1.6% in the 6 continuously covered states
